note: The preventive half. disableServiceAccountKeyCreation is not enforced, which is why the detective key check in gcp/iam.mjs can find keys tomorrow even if it finds none today. publicAccessPrevention is enforced but carries an exception, which reads as compliant on a dashboard and is not. vmExternalIpAccess was denied rather than absent, so it is a gap.

required.why: prevents downloadable service account keys being created at all
prevents a bucket being made public regardless of its own IAM
prevents a database being given a public address
forces SSH through IAM rather than metadata-distributed keys
prevents sharing with identities outside the organization
